sections.title: 2. Biggest three savings
items: A1, measuring itself: no agent of Indi's can be tuned until it reports. Evidence: Angelo's 31 lines vs Indi's 0.
Synthetic's long session (brief 1): 173,399 cache reads per call. Waits on run 3.

Idle wakes: since brief 2, conductor made 6 commits and dashboard 4; dev, designer and six others made none. Once they measure, any wake that does nothing is a candidate to slow down, as Angelo did with his helper (12 wakes, 3 commits).

sections.title: 4. Agents not yet measuring
sections.text: All ten. Asked 4 Nov: conductor, dev, dashboard, designer. Asked 5 Nov: messaging, factory, builder, ux, journalist, synthetic (asks.md). Not asked again. A3 (fresh conductor sessions) waits on A1.

sections.title: 5. Data notes and 6. My own use
sections.text: One ledger line in the window (mine, 5 Nov 17:36, covering Indi's report and guide and wake 2). Commit counts and Angelo's line counts from git. My use is above the measured saving (none) for a second day; review on 11 November. This wake: in brief 4.
